verdict.rationale: Letta Code documents a dedicated headless mode that runs the CLI non-interactively for scripts, CI/CD pipelines and composition with UNIX tools, and adds an --ephemeral flag for one-shot tasks that persist no agent state. A login-free local mode, the programmatic Agent SDK and scheduled tasks further support unattended automation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use, and documented details on CI integration specifics (e.g. output formats, exit codes, CI auth setup).
